title: [NatWest demo] Payments by location - Madrid p95 breach
description: Computes Madrid p95 latency at the api-gateway over the last 5 minutes from the OTel trace stream. Fires one ITSI notable when Madrid p95 exceeds 1500ms - the same threshold as the Splunk Observability detector '[NatWest demo] Madrid p95 latency', so Episode Review correlates the audit-side and observability-side signals into a single Episode. Pairs with the chaos scenario `madrid-network-degradation` (which dials the traffic-generator LOCATION_LATENCY_PROFILES from baseline ~450ms to ~2000ms). The dedupe key (cohort_key) collapses repeated firings inside the same 5-minute window so on-call sees one ticket per incident, not five.
search: index=otel_traces sourcetype="otel:traces" service.name=api-gateway (kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER" OR span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER") | rename "attributes.customer.location" as customer_location | rename "attributes.customer.country" as customer_country | where customer_location="madrid" | eval duration_ns = coalesce(duration_ns, end_time - start_time) | bin _time span=5m | stats perc95(duration_ns) as p95_ns, count as total by _time, customer_location, customer_country | eval p95_ms = round(p95_ns / 1000000, 0) | where p95_ms > 1500 AND total > 30 | eval severity = case(p95_ms > 3000, "6", p95_ms > 2000, "5", true(), "4") | eval service = "Payments by Location" | eval title = "Madrid p95 latency " . p95_ms . "ms (" . total . " payments)" | eval cohort_key = "madrid_p95:" . strftime(_time, "%Y%m%d%H%M") | eval source = "Splunk ES - payments OTel" | eval description = title . " - investigate traffic-generator LOCATION_LATENCY_PROFILES (madrid-network-degradation chaos) before chasing a real Spanish-link outage." | table _time, severity, service, title, source, customer_location, customer_country, p95_ms, total, cohort_key, description
action.itsi_event_generator.param.title: $result.title$
